scope: All 272 exact-lock registry packages, including build-only and target-specific dependencies; original source notices and preserved copyright/license comment blocks; pinned Rust 1.100.0 toolchain notices; separately preserved Microsoft build-product/runtime license sources. Project MIT does not relicense third-party components.

source_method.notice_collection: License, licence, copying, notice, copyright, unlicense and authors files, plus files under licenses/licences directories. Original bytes are preserved. README license claims are not substituted for license text.
source_method.cached_archive_verification: Every current locked registry archive matched Cargo.lock SHA-256. Retained archive-sourced notice slices were checked against their member bytes; new and updated package notices were read from locked archives without extraction. Repository supplements remain separately identified.
source_method.supplemental_review: Packages without a license file in the published crate archive (jsonschema-regex 0.63.1, jsonschema-value 0.63.1, rsqlite-vfs 0.2.0, plus retained unchanged supplements) are supplemented from exact crate VCS commits and same-commit cached siblings.
source_method.source_header_review: Preserved 333 distinct per-package copyright/permission/disclaimer comment blocks across retained packages, including vendored AWS-LC and target-specific sources.
